app.title: Shared Workspace
app.subtitle: A personal workspace across your devices

login.title: Login — Shared Workspace
login.heading: Shared Workspace
login.error_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Try again later.
login.hint: Your devices sync using the same account. Use HTTPS for transport encryption.

register.title: Register — Shared Workspace
register.heading: Create Account
register.error_password_short: Password must be at least 6 characters
register.hint_auto: Auto-approval enabled — login immediately after registration
register.hint_manual: Admin will review and approve your account

workspace.title: Shared Workspace
workspace.clipboard_placeholder:
Paste or type text here…
Syncs with your other signed-in devices
workspace.drop_text: Drag & drop files here or click to select
workspace.account_note: Each account has its own workspace. All devices using the same account sync in real time.
workspace.archive_hint: Archive conversations by date. Dates include both days in Macau time. Organize files in drive folders.
workspace.delete_file_confirm: Delete this file? Attachments in archived conversations will be kept.
workspace.clear_chat_confirm: Clear all unarchived conversations for your account on every device? This cannot be undone. Existing archives will be kept.
workspace.clear_files_confirm: Clear all unarchived files for your account on every device? This cannot be undone. Existing archives and their attachments will be kept.
workspace.restore_confirm: Restore this archive to the active workspace? Existing content will be kept. The previous shared clipboard stays in its archive.
workspace.storage_hint: Includes files, archives and text content. 1 GB = 1024 MB. Archiving does not free space.
workspace.delete_archive_confirm: Permanently delete this conversation archive? Files in your drive will be kept.

errors.too_many_requests: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.invalid_date_range: End date must not precede start date
errors.empty_archive: No unarchived content in this date range
errors.Too many files: Upload at most 10 files at a time
errors.Unexpected field: Upload at most 10 files at a time
errors.quota_exceeded: Storage limit reached. Remove content or ask an administrator to raise your limit. Archives count toward storage.
errors.invalid_quota: Capacity must be positive and at most 1 TB
errors.invalid_message: Message is empty or exceeds 10,000 characters
errors.username_format: Use 3–20 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens
errors.password_short: Use at least 6 characters for the password
errors.password_long: New passwords must be at most 72 UTF-8 bytes
errors.last_admin: The last active administrator cannot delete their account or lose administrator access
errors.invalid_site_name: Site name must be at most 80 characters and contain no control characters
errors.invalid_recipient: Recipient is missing, disabled or is your own account
errors.invalid_share_link: Enter a valid share link from this website
errors.already_owned: This file already belongs to your account
errors.protected_admin: The initial administrator account cannot be deleted.
errors.protected_admin_name: The initial administrator's username is fixed. You can still change its password and theme.
errors.protected_admin_role: The initial administrator's administrator access cannot be revoked.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot revoke your own administrator access
errors.not_admin: This account is already a regular user
errors.invalid_theme: Choose a dark or white theme
errors.inactive_user: Activate or approve this user before promoting them to administrator
errors.invalid_folder_name: Use 1–120 characters without slashes or control characters; dot-only names are not allowed
errors.folder_exists: A folder with this name already exists here
errors.folder_cycle: A folder cannot be moved into itself or its descendants
errors.folder_limit: Each account supports at most 1000 folders
errors.invalid_timeout: Idle timeout must be a whole number between 5 and 86400 seconds
errors.network_error: The network connection was lost. Please retry.
errors.invalid_key_scopes: Select at least one valid permission.
errors.invalid_key_expiry: Validity must be an integer from 1 to 365 days.
errors.agent_key_limit: At most 20 active keys are allowed. Revoke an unused key first.
errors.invalid_agent_key: Invalid, expired or revoked API key.
errors.insufficient_scope: The key does not grant this operation.
errors.invalid_clipboard: Clipboard text is invalid or too long.

account.title: My account
account.hint: Changing your username or password signs other devices out. Existing content is kept.
account.new_password: New password (leave blank to keep it)
account.saved: Account updated. Other devices need to sign in again.
account.delete_hint: Permanently remove your clipboard, conversations, files, archives and shares, and sign out all devices. Copies already received belong to their recipients.
account.type_username: Type your current username to confirm
account.delete_confirm: Permanently delete your account and all personal data? This cannot be undone.
account.last_admin_hint: At least one active administrator must remain. The last administrator cannot delete their account.

sharing.title: File sharing
sharing.hint: Anyone with a public link can download. User-restricted shares are available only to the selected accounts.
sharing.link_placeholder: Paste a share link from this website
sharing.no_users: No other active users. You can create a public share.
sharing.copy_hint: Receiving a file creates a copy in your space and counts toward your quota. Revoking a share keeps copies already received.
sharing.imported: File received. You can find it in your workspace.
sharing.revoke_confirm: Revoking invalidates the original link. Downloaded and received copies are kept. Revoke this share?
sharing.revoked: Share revoked. The original link no longer works.

preferences.title: Appearance
preferences.hint: Your theme is saved to your account and follows you when you sign in on another device.

drive.empty: This folder is empty. Create a folder or upload files.
drive.delete_files_confirm: Permanently delete the selected files? Their shares and conversation attachments will also be removed.
drive.delete_folder_confirm: Permanently delete this folder, all subfolders and files? Related shares and attachments will also be removed.

connection.idle: Disconnected after inactivity. Resume the connection to continue syncing.

agents.title: Agent access
agents.hint: Let assistants use your drive and web clipboard through the API, MCP or CLI. Keys grant only selected permissions and never account administration.
agents.label: Assistant name
agents.show_once: This key is shown only after creation. Save it privately; lost keys must be replaced.
agents.revoke_confirm: This assistant will immediately lose access. Revoke its key?
agents.setup_hint: Download the GitHub repository and install dependencies, then add this configuration to an MCP-compatible assistant. The CLI and HTTP API use the same key.
agents.guide: Read the full setup guide and command examples
agents.config_hint: Replace example paths with paths on your computer. Keep the key in a separate private file and put only its path in this configuration.
agents.local_files_hint: MCP file transfers are restricted to CLIPTALK_LOCAL_DIR. Downloads never overwrite existing files.
agents.transport_hint: This is public HTTP. Open the site through HTTPS or an SSH tunnel before creating a key, to avoid sending it in plaintext. The included MCP and CLI reject public HTTP.
agents.audit_hint: The latest 1,000 authenticated API calls show time, assistant, action and result. Clipboard text, file bodies and keys are never logged. Changing your account password revokes all keys.
agents.copy_manually: Please copy the selected key manually.
